definitions.gloss: section; segment; interval (of a route or range)
definitions.explanation: A defined portion of a route, track, or range, often used for transportation routes, distance measurements, or mathematical intervals.

examples.japanese: この{区間|くかん}は{工事中|こうじちゅう}だ。
{東京|とうきょう}から{大阪|おおさか}までの{区間|くかん}は{約|やく}500キロある。
examples.english: The section from Tokyo to Osaka is about 500 kilometers.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}の{一部|いちぶ}の{区間|くかん}で{速度制限|そくどせいげん}が{変更|へんこう}された。
examples.english: The speed limit was changed on some sections of the expressway.

notes: Common collocations: {区間|くかん}{運転|うんてん} (service on a limited section of a train line), {区間|くかん}{快速|かいそく} (semi-rapid train that runs express on a limited section). In mathematics, {区間|くかん} refers to an interval on a number line. Often appears on train signs and announcements to indicate which portion of a route is affected by delays or service changes. Related: {区域|くいき} (area, zone — refers to a two-dimensional area rather than a linear section).
